Rail icons fill when selected, with a small grow as they switch, and the Scratchpad now uses a sticky-note icon. Picture backgrounds gain a Pixel texture (on by default) that softens them into a fine dot matrix.

Tabs no longer repeat their title under the tab bar, the New tab, Subagents, Attention and Bot tabs open straight into their content, the session card drops its close button, and the new-tab button lines up with the tabs. The files-changed summary under a finished turn has its card fill again.

Bundles gateway 0.16.33 (protocol 93), unchanged from 0.10.7. Build 24.
